## COMING SOON with a Wiki that you might need.

![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/badge/Coming-soon-yellow?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)
![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Coming-soon-yellow?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)

Prixilium is a virus-based mod with a ton of new Items, Blocks, Entity and unique mechanics that you'll have to fide out.

You can download the mod from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/prixilium) or the [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/NapsterNPT/prixilium/releases/); any other source will be marked as unofficial.

If you want to see the source code or report an issue [Click Here](https://github.com/NapsterNPT/prixilium/issues).
